description.narrative:
This money will be funding the first version of Bonn Climate Camp will be held during the upcoming SB60 in Bonn, Germany. The Camp will be the space forsupporting the mobilization of activists and civil society from the global south and the most affectedpeople and areas (MAPA).We envision the camp as a welcoming, accessible, and safer space that centers the voices, leadership, and demands of activists from the Global South and MostAffected Peoples and Areas (MAPAs).The money will mainly support the logistical needs of thecamp, and cover travel costs for international activists with a focus on the global south activists andMAPA. In addition, the grantwill also cover the reimbursement for volunteers coordinating and organizing this camp.In summary, thisgrant will be used in:1- Hosting the dynamic space of the Bonn Climate Camp, being the space for Civil society organization groups.2- Training to improve efficiency, planning, financial, influencing (also in campaigns), fundraising capacities

In addition, the grant will also cover the reimbursement for volunteers coordinating and organizing this camp.In summary,thisgrant will be used in:1- Hosting the dynamic space of the BonnClimate Camp, being the space for Civil society organization groups.2- Training to improve efficiency, planning, financial, influencing (also in campaigns), fundraising capacitiesWhat does your organization hope to achieve by the end of this grant? *15.We envision the camp as a welcoming, accessible, and safer space that centers the voices, leadership, and demands of activists from the GlobalSouth and MostAffected Peoples and Areas (MAPAs). Thecamp will provide a platform to amplify those who often lack access to international climateconversations and the power to shape critical decisions, despite being impacted first and worst bythe climate crisis. It is particularly difficult for MAPAactivists to participate in the conference. Manyare denied visas for the conference, cannot find affordable accommodation, and lack a place in Bonnto network or just relax. With the Bonn Climate Camp, we want to change this.OurPlan:The camp will give physicalspace to the emerging networks and coalitions of young and long-established constituencies with daily strategy sessions. We aim tomake it accessible to allinternational activists and increase perspectives in the German and Europeanmovement of globaljustice campaigns. The camp is open from May 31st until June 14th.
